summary: Feed s076_single is healthy for SIEM delivery. No packet drops, overload, duplicates, VLAN gaps or excessive encryption. 35.8% one-way TCP sessions detected (73/204) but SIEM profile needs_both_directions=false so coverage remains adequate.

findings.root_cause: 73 of 204 TCP sessions (35.8%) show only one direction, exceeding 10% threshold. Most likely only one direction is being delivered to the tool port — e.g., SPAN configured RX-only, only one side of a duplex TAP connected, packet broker splitting directions across different tool ports without aggregation, or asymmetric routing with single-path tap.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM has needs_both_directions=false and needs_full_payload=false, so it can generate events from unidirectional flows. Missing return traffic does not break ingestion but reduces full session context for correlation/stateful analytics.

recommended_fix.why: No immediate broker change required per SIEM profile tolerance for one-way traffic. If richer session context is desired, optionally configure packet broker to aggregate both directions of each flow to the same SIEM port.
